<!-- hermes-sweeper:item=1572 -->
<!-- hermes-sweeper:verdict=close reason=not_planned confidence=high -->
Thanks for the clear local-latency use case. This automated hermes-sweeper review is closing this under the current model-routing policy.

- The request is for intent/complexity classification followed by automatic provider:model selection for individual prompts and later chain turns.
- That is covered by the standing `delegation-model-routing` policy: Hermes does not add complexity-based automatic routing or per-call/per-task model/provider overrides.
- The related PR #1790 was closed without merging; its discussion is useful context on why keyword classification was rejected, but it does not change the current routing policy.
- For a fixed subagent configuration, use the supported `delegation.provider` and `delegation.model` settings in `config.yaml`; automatic per-prompt selection is not a supported core direction.

---
*Closed as not-planned per standing maintainer policy (`delegation-model-routing`). This is a design-direction decision, not a code-quality judgment — see the Contribution Rubric in `AGENTS.md` for what the project is looking for. If you believe this policy was misapplied to your change, comment here and a maintainer will take a look.*
